---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or a format change for keepsake
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**Problem**

What workflow pain or gap are you hitting? Describe the export, note source, or
agent recall path that keepsake does not currently handle. If this touches the
format, say whether it can be done within `keepsake/v1` or needs a new version.

**Proposed solution**

What you would like keepsake to do. If you are proposing a format change, sketch
the members involved and how canonical JSON, hashing, or the Merkle root would
be affected. If it is an import change, name the source format and the role and
timestamp mapping you expect.

**Alternatives**

Any workarounds you use today, and why they are not good enough.
